requirements.text: The sample(s) of the ESA shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation.
requirements.source_quote: The sample(s) shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation.

requirements.text: ESAs, which are intentional RF transmitters, which have not received type approval in conjunction with a vehicle manufacturer, shall be supplied with suitable installation guidelines.
requirements.source_quote: ESAs, which are intentional RF transmitters, which have not received type approval in conjunction with a vehicle manufacturer, shall be supplied with suitable installation guidelines.
requirements.saved_condition: Applies if the radar/LIDAR or keyless-entry aerial ESAs are type-approved without a vehicle manufacturer.

requirements.text: The electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) conforming to a type approved under this Regulation shall have an approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. affixed to it, except that no marking is required for electrical/electronic systems built into vehicles which are approved as units.
requirements.source_quote: Electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) An approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. below shall be affixed to every ESA conforming to a type approved under this Regulation. No marking is required for electrical/electronic systems built into vehicles which are approved as units.
requirements.saved_condition: Applies if the bumper ESAs are type-approved as ESAs (not only at vehicle level).

requirements.text: The international approval mark shall comprise a circle containing the letter "E", followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.
requirements.source_quote: A circle containing the letter "E", followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.
requirements.saved_condition: Applies if the bumper ESAs are type-approved as ESAs.

requirements.text: The international approval mark shall comprise the number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle specified in paragraph 5.3.1.
requirements.source_quote: The number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle specified in paragraph 5.3.1. above.
requirements.saved_condition: Applies if the bumper ESAs are type-approved as ESAs.

requirements.text: A vehicle and its electrical/electronic system(s) or ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.source_quote: A vehicle and its electrical/electronic system(s) or ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.

requirements.text: The ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions, for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.
requirements.source_quote: ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions, for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.
requirements.saved_condition: Applies if the bumper ESAs are type-approved as ESAs.

requirements.text: The broadband electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.
requirements.source_quote: Method of measurement The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6 to this Regulation.
requirements.source_quote: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6 to this Regulation.

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the limit in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band shall remain constant at 63 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.source_quote: In the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the limit remains constant at 63 dB microvolts/m.

requirements.text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured broadband values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.source_quote: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.

requirements.text: The narrowband electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 8.
requirements.source_quote: Method of measurement The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 8.

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the limits shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 7.
requirements.source_quote: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the limits shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 7.

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the limit in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band shall remain constant at 53 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.source_quote: In the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the limit remains constant at 53 dB microvolts/m.

requirements.text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured narrowband value, expressed in dB microvolts/m shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.source_quote: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured value, expressed in dB microvolts/m shall be below the type approval limits.

requirements.text: The emission of transient conducted disturbances on 12/24 V supply lines of ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10 for the levels given in Table 1.
requirements.source_quote: Method of testing The emission of ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10 for the levels given in Table 1.

requirements.text: For positive polarity, the maximum allowed pulse amplitude of the ESA shall be +75 V for vehicles with 12 V systems and +150 V for vehicles with 24 V systems as given in Table 1.
requirements.source_quote: Table 1 Maximum allowed pulse amplitude ... Positive +75 V +150 V

requirements.text: For negative polarity, the maximum allowed pulse amplitude of the ESA shall be -100 V for vehicles with 12 V systems and -450 V for vehicles with 24 V systems as given in Table 1.
requirements.source_quote: Table 1 Maximum allowed pulse amplitude ... Negative -100 V -450 V

requirements.text: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) chosen from those described in Annex 9.
requirements.source_quote: Method(s) of testing The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) chosen from those described in Annex 9.

requirements.text: The ESA representative of its type shall be tested for immunity to electromagnetic radiation such that test severity in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band are given in Table 2a.
requirements.source_quote: Test severity in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band are given in Table 2a.

requirements.text: The ESA representative of its type shall be tested for immunity to electromagnetic radiation such that test severity for the minimum test Level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band is as given in Table 2b.
requirements.source_quote: Test severity for the minimum test Level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band given in Table 2b.

requirements.text: The ESA representative of its type shall be tested for immunity to electromagnetic radiation by the method(s) as described in Annex 9.
requirements.source_quote: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) as described in Annex 9:

requirements.text: During the tests performed in accordance with Annex 9, there shall be no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions" of the ESA representative of its type.
requirements.source_quote: The ESA representative of its type shall be considered as complying with immunity requirements if, during the tests performed in accordance with Annex 9, there shall be no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions".

requirements.text: The immunity of ESA representative of this type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 16750-2 for starting profile and ISO 7637-2 for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b, as described in Annex 10, with the test levels given in Tables 3a and 3b.
requirements.source_quote: Method of testing The immunity of ESA representative of this type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 16750-2 for starting profile and ISO 7637-2 for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b, as described in Annex 10, with the test levels given in Tables 3a and 3b.

requirements.text: For pulse 1, the ESA shall meet immunity test level -75 V (12V system) or -450 V (24V system) for 500 pulses with FPSC III for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
requirements.source_quote: 1 -75 V -450 V 500 pulses III III

requirements.text: For pulse 2a, the ESA shall meet immunity test level +37 V (12V system) or +37 V (24V system) for 500 pulses with FPSC I for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
requirements.source_quote: 2a +37 V +37 V 500 pulses I III

requirements.text: For pulse 2b, the ESA shall meet immunity test level +10 V (12V system) or +20 V (24V system) for 10 pulses with FPSC II for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
requirements.source_quote: 2b +10 V +20 V 10 pulses II III

requirements.text: For pulse 3a, the ESA shall meet immunity test level -112 V (12V system) or -150 V (24V system) for 1 h with FPSC I for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
requirements.source_quote: 3a -112 V -150 V 1 h I III

requirements.text: For pulse 3b, the ESA shall meet immunity test level +75 V (12V system) or +150 V (24V system) for 1 h with FPSC I for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
requirements.source_quote: 3b +75 V +150 V 1 h I III

requirements.text: The Functional Performance Status Classification (FPSC) as in ISO 7637-1 shall be applied for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b.
requirements.source_quote: Functional Performance Status Classification (FPSC) as in ISO 7637-1 shall be applied for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b.

requirements.text: The starting profile shall be tested according to the functional status classification as defined in ISO 16750-1.
requirements.source_quote: Starting profile shall be tested according to the functional status classification as defined in ISO 16750-1.
requirements.saved_condition: ESA could be installed in vehicles with internal combustion engines started with a 12V/24V starter motor

requirements.text: For the 12 V system starting profile (ISO 16750-2, test level II, 10 pulses), an ESA that shall be operational during engine start phases shall reach functional status class B if it performs immunity-related functions and class D if it does not, and any other ESA shall reach class C, as given in Table 3a; the starting profile applies only to ESAs that may be installed in vehicles with an internal combustion engine started by a 12 V / 24 V starter motor.
requirements.source_quote: Starting profile II II 10 pulses (for ESA which shall be operational during engine start phases) C (for other ESA) ... Starting profile is only applicable to ESAs that could be installed in vehicles with internal combustion engines which are started with a 12V/24V starter motor.
requirements.saved_condition: ESA could be installed in vehicles with internal combustion engines started with a 12V/24V starter motor; 12 V system

requirements.text: For the 24 V system starting profile (ISO 16750-2, test level II, 10 pulses), an ESA that shall be operational during engine start phases shall reach functional status class B if it performs immunity-related functions and class D if it does not, and any other ESA shall reach class C, as given in Table 3a; the starting profile applies only to ESAs that may be installed in vehicles with an internal combustion engine started by a 12 V / 24 V starter motor.
requirements.source_quote: Starting profile II II 10 pulses (for ESA which shall be operational during engine start phases) C (for other ESA) ... Starting profile is only applicable to ESAs that could be installed in vehicles with internal combustion engines which are started with a 12V/24V starter motor.
requirements.saved_condition: ESA could be installed in vehicles with internal combustion engines started with a 12V/24V starter motor; 24 V system

requirements.text: RF transmitters shall be tested in the transmit mode.
requirements.source_quote: RF transmitters shall be tested in the transmit mode.
requirements.saved_condition: ESA contains an RF transmitter (radar, keyless-entry aerial)

requirements.text: Spurious emissions of RF transmitters shall be subject to this Regulation, except that wanted emissions within the necessary bandwidth and out of band emissions are disregarded for the purpose of this Regulation.
requirements.source_quote: Wanted emissions (e.g. from RF transmitting systems) within the necessary bandwidth and out of band emissions are disregarded for the purpose of this Regulation. Spurious emissions are subject to this Regulation.
requirements.saved_condition: ESA contains an RF transmitter (radar, keyless-entry aerial)

requirements.text: Vehicles or components or ESAs approved under this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set forth in paragraph 6. and, if applicable, in paragraph 7.
requirements.source_quote: Vehicles or components or ESAs approved under this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set forth in paragraph 6. and, if applicable, in paragraph 7. above.

requirements.text: When the conformity of a vehicle, component or ESA taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to broadband electromagnetic disturbances and narrowband electromagnetic disturbances if the levels measured do not exceed by more than 4 dB (60 per cent) the reference limits prescribed in paragraphs 6.2.2.1., 6.2.2.2., 6.3.2.1., 6.3.2.2. and, if applicable, paragraphs 7.2.2.1. and 7.2.2.2. for vehicles and paragraphs 6.5.2.1., 6.6.2.1., and, if applicable, paragraph 7.10.2.1. for ESAs (as appropriate).
requirements.source_quote: When the conformity of a vehicle, component or ESA taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to broadband electromagnetic disturbances and narrowband electromagnetic disturbances if the levels measured do not exceed by more than 4 dB (60 per cent) the reference limits prescribed in paragraphs 6.2.2.1., 6.2.2.2., 6.3.2.1., 6.3.2.2. and, if applicable, paragraphs 7.2.2.1. and 7.2.2.2. for vehicles and paragraphs 6.5.2.1., 6.6.2.1., and, if applicable, paragraph 7.10.2.1. above for ESAs (as appropriate).

requirements.text: When the conformity of a vehicle, component or ESA taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to immunity to electromagnetic radiation if the vehicle ESA does not exhibit any degradation relating to the direct control of the vehicle which could be observed by the driver or other road user when the vehicle is in the state defined in Annex 6, paragraph 4., and is subjected to a field strength, expressed in Volts/m, up to 80 per cent of the reference limits prescribed in paragraph 6.4.2.1., and, if applicable, paragraph 7.7.2.1. for vehicles and paragraph 6.8.2.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.18.2.1. for ESAs.
requirements.source_quote: When the conformity of a vehicle, component or ESA taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to immunity to electromagnetic radiation if the vehicle ESA does not exhibit any degradation relating to the direct control of the vehicle which could be observed by the driver or other road user when the vehicle is in the state defined in Annex 6, paragraph 4., and is subjected to a field strength, expressed in Volts/m, up to 80 per cent of the reference limits prescribed in paragraph 6.4.2.1., and, if applicable, paragraph 7.7.2.1. for vehicles and paragraph 6.8.2.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.18.2.1. for ESAs above.

requirements.text: When the conformity of a component, or Separate Technical Unit (STU) taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to immunity to conducted disturbances and emission if the component or STU shows no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions" up to levels given in paragraph 6.9.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.19.1., and does not exceed the levels given in paragraph 6.7.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.17.1.
requirements.source_quote: If the conformity of a component, or Separate Technical Unit (STU) taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to immunity to conducted disturbances and emission if the component or STU shows no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions" up to levels given in paragraph 6.9.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.19.1., and does not exceed the levels given in paragraph 6.7.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.17.1. above.

requirements.text: For the 30-75 MHz frequency band, the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) broadband reference limit shall be E = 62 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1. of this Regulation).
requirements.source_quote: Limit E (dBµV/m) at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth 30-75 MHz ... E = 62 - 25.13 log (F/30)

requirements.text: For the 75-400 MHz frequency band, the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) broadband reference limit shall be E = 52 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1. of this Regulation).
requirements.source_quote: Limit E (dBµV/m) at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth ... 75-400 MHz ... E = 52 + 15.13 log (F/75)

requirements.text: For the 400-1,000 MHz frequency band, the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) broadband reference limit shall be E = 63 dBµV/m for a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1. of this Regulation).
requirements.source_quote: Limit E (dBµV/m) at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth ... 400-1,000 MHz ... E = 63

requirements.text: For the 30-75 MHz frequency band, the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) narrowband reference limit shall be E = 52 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraph 6.6.2.1. of this Regulation).
requirements.source_quote: Limit E (dBµV/m) at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth 30-75 MHz ... E = 52 - 25.13 log (F/30)

requirements.text: For the 75-400 MHz frequency band, the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) narrowband reference limit shall be E = 42 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraph 6.6.2.1. of this Regulation).
requirements.source_quote: Limit E (dBµV/m) at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth ... 75-400 MHz ... E = 42 + 15.13 log (F/75)

requirements.text: For the 400-1,000 MHz frequency band, the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) narrowband reference limit shall be E = 53 dBµV/m for a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraph 6.6.2.1. of this Regulation).
requirements.source_quote: Limit E (dBµV/m) at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth ... 400-1,000 MHz ... E = 53

requirements.text: If not otherwise stated in this Annex, the test of broadband electromagnetic emissions from ESAs shall be performed according to CISPR 25.
requirements.source_quote: This test is intended to measure broadband electromagnetic emissions from ESAs (e.g. ignition systems, electric motor, onboard battery charging unit, etc.). If not otherwise stated in this Annex the test shall be performed according CISPR 25.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
requirements.source_quote: The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.

requirements.text: For ESA other than involved in "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" the test shall be performed according to the ALSE method described in Clause 6.4 of CISPR 25.
requirements.source_quote: For ESA other than involved in "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" the test shall be performed according to the ALSE method described in Clause 6.4 of CISPR 25.

requirements.text: To ensure that there is no extraneous noise or signal of a magnitude sufficient to affect materially the measurement, ambient measurements shall be taken before or after the main test.
requirements.source_quote: To ensure that there is no extraneous noise or signal of a magnitude sufficient to affect materially the measurement, measurements shall be taken before or after the main test.

requirements.text: In the ambient measurement, the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.5.2.1. of this Regulation, except for intentional narrowband ambient transmissions.
requirements.source_quote: In this measurement, the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.5.2.1. of this Regulation, except for intentional narrowband ambient transmissions.

requirements.text: The limits shall apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).
requirements.source_quote: The limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).

requirements.text: If peak detectors are used for the measurements, a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied.
requirements.source_quote: Measurements can be performed with either quasi-peak or peak detectors. The limits given in paragraphs 6.5. and 7.10. of this Regulation are for quasi-peak detectors. If peak detectors are used a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied.

requirements.text: The measurements shall be performed with a spectrum analyser or a scanning receiver.
requirements.source_quote: The measurements shall be performed with a spectrum analyser or a scanning receiver.

requirements.text: Unless otherwise specified the configuration with the LV harness closer to the antenna shall be tested.
requirements.source_quote: Unless otherwise specified the configuration with the LV harness closer to the antenna shall be tested.

requirements.text: If not otherwise stated in this Annex, the test to measure the narrowband electromagnetic emissions from the ESA shall be performed according to CISPR 25.
requirements.source_quote: If not otherwise stated in this Annex the test shall be performed according to CISPR 25.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
requirements.source_quote: The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.

requirements.text: The narrowband emission test of the ESA shall be performed according to ALSE method described in paragraph 6.4. of CISPR 25.
requirements.source_quote: The test shall be performed according to ALSE method described in paragraph 6.4. of CISPR 25.

requirements.text: The narrowband emission limits shall apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).
requirements.source_quote: The limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).

requirements.text: The narrowband emission measurements shall be performed with an average detector.
requirements.source_quote: Measurements shall be performed with an average detector.

requirements.text: ESAs may comply with the requirements of any combination of the following test methods at the manufacturer's discretion provided that these results in the full frequency range specified in paragraph 3.1. of this Annex being covered: (a) Absorber chamber test according to ISO 11452-2; (b) TEM cell testing according to ISO 11452-3; (c) Bulk current injection testing according to ISO 11452-4; (d) Stripline testing according to ISO 11452-5; (e) Reverberation chamber test according to ISO 11452-11.
requirements.source_quote: ESAs may comply with the requirements of any combination of the following test methods at the manufacturer's discretion provided that these results in the full frequency range specified in paragraph 3.1. of this Annex being covered: (a) Absorber chamber test according to ISO 11452-2; (b) TEM cell testing according to ISO 11452-3; (c) Bulk current injection testing according to ISO 11452-4; (d) Stripline testing according to ISO 11452-5; (e) Reverberation chamber test according to ISO 11452-11;

requirements.text: The frequency range and general test conditions for the immunity tests of ESAs to electromagnetic radiation shall be based on ISO 11452-1.
requirements.source_quote: (Frequency range and general test conditions shall be based on ISO 11452-1).

requirements.text: The test conditions for the ESA during tests shall be according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.source_quote: The test conditions shall be according to ISO 11452-1.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be switched on.
requirements.source_quote: The ESA under test shall be switched on and shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition.
requirements.source_quote: The ESA under test shall be switched on and shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be arranged as defined in this Annex unless individual test methods dictate otherwise.
requirements.source_quote: It shall be arranged as defined in this Annex unless individual test methods dictate otherwise.

requirements.text: Measurements shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.source_quote: Measurements shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.

requirements.text: The test signal modulation shall be AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range, if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer.
requirements.source_quote: The test signal modulation shall be: (a) AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range; (b) PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range; and (c) PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges. If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer.

requirements.text: The test signal modulation shall be PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range, if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer.
requirements.source_quote: The test signal modulation shall be: (a) AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range; (b) PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range; and (c) PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges. If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer.

requirements.text: The test signal modulation shall be PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges, if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer.
requirements.source_quote: The test signal modulation shall be: (a) AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range; (b) PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range; and (c) PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges. If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer.

requirements.text: Frequency step size and dwell time shall be chosen according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.source_quote: Frequency step size and dwell time shall be chosen according to ISO 11452-1.

requirements.text: For the absorber chamber test, the "substitution method" shall be used to establish the test field conditions according to ISO 11452-2.
requirements.source_quote: The "substitution method" shall be used to establish the test field conditions according to ISO 11452-2.
requirements.saved_condition: The absorber chamber test (ISO 11452-2) is among the chosen test methods

requirements.text: The absorber chamber test shall be performed with vertical polarization.
requirements.source_quote: The test shall be performed with vertical polarization.
requirements.saved_condition: The absorber chamber test (ISO 11452-2) is among the chosen test methods

requirements.text: The TEM cell test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-3.
requirements.source_quote: The test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-3.
requirements.saved_condition: TEM cell method selected for the radiated immunity test of the bumper ESAs

requirements.text: The bulk current injection test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-4 on a test bench with the following characteristics: BCI test method with substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA; or BCI test method with closed loop method and injection probe positioned at 900 mm distance to the ESA, except that as an alternative the ESA may be tested while installed in the vehicle according to ISO 11451-4 with the following characteristics: BCI test method with substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA.
requirements.source_quote: The test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-4 on a test bench with the following characteristics: BCI test method with substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA;Or BCI test method with closed loop method and injection probe positioned at 900 mm distance to the ESA. As an alternative the ESA may be tested while installed in the vehicle according to ISO 11451-4 with the following characteristics: BCI test method with substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA.
requirements.saved_condition: BCI method selected for the immunity test of the bumper ESAs

requirements.text: The stripline test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-5.
requirements.source_quote: The test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-5.
requirements.saved_condition: Stripline method selected for the radiated immunity test of the bumper ESAs

requirements.text: The reverberation chamber test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-11.
